DitherBadge.variant: default, secondary, destructive or outline. Destructive turns red unless you set a colour.
DitherBadge.dot: Shows a status dot. dot-color sets its colour.
DitherBadge.removable: Shows a small cross. Clicking it calls removed.
DitherBadge.dot-color: Colour of the leading dot. Transparent draws no dot.
DitherBadge.removed: Called when the remove button of a removable badge is pressed.
